newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end higher, Wall St guides.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end higher, Wall St guides.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Belgian shares closed higher on Tuesday, reversing earlier losses after a slightly lower-than-expected rise in U.S. labour cost data boosted Wall Street in the afternoon. Stronger dollar also supporting.
* Future direction tied up with Dow Jones performance, dealers said, though some predicted a little more consolidation before resumption of recent record rally.
* Bel-20 index .BFX ends 6.45 points or 0.32 percent higher at 2,050.44 with volume a moderate 2.5 billion francs worth of Belgian shares changing hands.
